content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

Not necessarily. Research shows you can build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets are taken close to failure (about 0 to 3 reps left in the tank). Lighter weights just need more reps, and they tend to cost more time and fatigue.

Heavy work still matters for your 100 kg bench goal, though. Strength is specific, so you need to practice heavy, low-rep benching (around 3 to 6 reps) to hit that number. 💪 A mix works best: heavy compounds first, then moderate-rep (8 to 15) accessory work for size.
